输入 {0} 的新名称；目标已存在时操作会被拒绝。: Enter a new name for {0}; rejected if the target exists.
输入 Redis 命令，Enter 执行…: Type a Redis command; Enter to run…
输入分组名，相同名称的连接会归入同一组；留空请使用“移出分组”。: Enter a group name; connections with the same name are grouped. Leave blank to use “Remove from group”.
输入新分组名，连接将移动到该分组。: Enter a new group name; the connection will move to it.
数据仅保存在本机，不上传: Data stays on this device; never uploaded
双击历史命令可填入输入框；认证类命令不会记录。: Double-click a history entry to fill the input; auth commands are never recorded.
搜索 Key、命令历史与页面…: Search keys, command history and pages…

添加一个 Redis 连接开始浏览数据: Add a Redis connection to start browsing
通过 SCAN 增量扫描当前 DB，并按 MEMORY USAGE 与元素数量识: Incrementally SCANs the current DB and finds big keys by MEMORY USAGE and element count. Never uses KEYS * and never modifies data.
拖拽到分组标题可快速移动分组；右键可设置分组: Drag onto a group header to move it; right-click to change the group
网络连接失败：目标主机不可达或端口未开放: Network error: host unreachable or port closed
为 Key 设置新的 TTL；选择“永不过期”将移除过期时间。: Set a new TTL for the key; choosing “No expiration” removes it.
未连接 · 从左侧选择连接并点击连接: Not connected · select a connection on the left and click Connect
未连接 Redis，请先在左侧建立连接。: Not connected to Redis; connect on the left first.
未连接：请先在左侧连接 Redis: Not connected: connect to Redis on the left first
无法连接 Redis：请检查 Host/Port、网络、防火墙或 SSH 隧道配: Cannot connect to Redis: check Host/Port, network, firewall or SSH tunnel settings
相同分组名的连接会在左侧列表中归为一组；留空显示在“未分组”: Connections with the same group appear together; blank means “Ungrouped”
小 / 标准 / 大，选择后立即应用到全部界面并保存: Small / standard / large; applied to the whole UI and saved immediately
写回 Redis 并保留原 TTL (Ctrl+S): Write back to Redis, keeping the original TTL (Ctrl+S)
写命令可能已在服务端生效。请先刷新数据确认，再决定是否重试。: The write may already have taken effect. Refresh to confirm before retrying.
写入结果未知，请刷新确认后重试: Write result unknown; refresh to confirm before retrying
新 Key 名称不能为空: New key name cannot be empty
新 Key 名称与原名相同: New key name is the same as the original
新的界面语言已保存。\n重启 WinRedis 后生效，是否现在重启？:
The new language has been saved.
Restart WinRedis to apply it. Restart now?
需要服务端配置 slowlog-log-slower-than；WinRedis: Requires slowlog-log-slower-than on the server; WinRedis never changes it.
选择连接与 Key 后开始比较: Pick connections and keys, then compare
选择一个 Key 查看详情: Select a key to view details
选择左右连接与 Key 后点击“开始比较”。两个会话均以只读方式建立，不会修改任: Pick connections and keys on both sides, then click “Compare”. Both sessions are read-only; no data is modified.
一次最多写入 500 个元素，请分批创建: Up to 500 elements per write; create in batches
已保存 SSH 密码，留空表示保持不变: SSH password saved; leave blank to keep it
已保存密码，留空表示保持不变: Password saved; leave blank to keep it
已保存私钥口令，留空表示保持不变: Passphrase saved; leave blank to keep it
已还原为最近一次读取的内容: Restored to the last loaded content
已恢复默认值，点击“保存设置”生效: Defaults restored; click “Save settings” to apply
已启用 SSH 隧道，但 SSH Host 为空: SSH tunnel enabled but the SSH host is empty
已取消切换，未保存的修改仍在编辑器中；点击原 Key 可继续编辑: Switch cancelled; unsaved changes remain in the editor. Click the original key to continue.
已取消数据库搜索，继续使用本地过滤: Database search cancelled; continuing with local filtering
用于目录视图拆分，例如 : 或 /: Used to split folder view paths, e.g. : or /
原值将被替换（TTL 保持不变）。此操作不可自动撤销。: The original value will be replaced (TTL unchanged). This cannot be undone automatically.
在命令终端执行的非敏感命令会记录在本机；认证类命令永不记录。: Non-sensitive commands run in the console are recorded locally; auth commands are never recorded.
在数据浏览中打开的 Key 会记录在本机；可在设置中关闭记录。: Keys opened in the data browser are recorded locally; disable this in settings.
在左侧连接卡片上显示颜色标记，仅用于本地提醒: Shows a color marker on the connection card (local reminder only)
这不会删除 Redis 服务端的数据。: This does not delete data on the Redis server.
支持 OpenSSH / PEM 私钥（.pem、id_rsa、id_ed255: Supports OpenSSH/PEM keys (.pem, id_rsa, id_ed25519, …); PuTTY .ppk is not supported
支持 String / Hash / List / Set / ZSet / S: Supports String / Hash / List / Set / ZSet / Stream. Strings are editable (TTL preserved); collections support paging and element-level writes.
执行 Redis 命令并查看风险级别: Run Redis commands with risk levels
执行被安全策略阻止：需要确认: Blocked by the safety policy: confirmation required
值不能为空（允许空字符串）: Value cannot be null (empty string allowed)
只读连接：命令 {0} 属于写操作，已被阻止。: Read-only connection: command {0} is a write and was blocked.
至少需要一个字段: At least one field is required
重命名当前 Key（目标存在时不会覆盖）: Rename this key (never overwrites an existing target)
主题、浏览、监控、历史与安全: Theme, browsing, monitoring, history and security
